===================================================================
--- packages/KNIRVAGENT/pkg/channels/dve.go

@@ -0,0 +1,84 @@
+package channels
+
+import (
+	"bytes"
+	"context"
+	"encoding/json"
+	"fmt"
+	"net/http"
+	"os"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/knirvcorp/knirvagent/pkg/bus"
+	"github.com/knirvcorp/knirvagent/pkg/logger"
+)
+
+type DVEChannel struct {
+	*BaseChannel
+	dveID     string
+	serverURL string
+	client    *http.Client
+}
+
+func NewDVEChannel(bus *bus.MessageBus) (*DVEChannel, error) {
+	dveID := os.Getenv("DVE_ID")
+	serverURL := os.Getenv("KNIRV_SERVER_URL")
+
+	if dveID == "" {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("DVE_ID environment variable not set")
+	}
+	if serverURL == "" {
+		serverURL = "http://host.docker.internal:8080" // Default fallback
+	}
+
+	return &DVEChannel{
+		BaseChannel: NewBaseChannel("dve", nil, bus, nil),
+		dveID:       dveID,
+		serverURL:   serverURL,
+		client:      &http.Client{Timeout: 10 * time.Second},
+	}, nil
+}
+
+func (c *DVEChannel) Start(ctx context.Context) error {
+	c.setRunning(true)
+	logger.InfoCF("channels", "DVE channel started", map[string]interface{}{
+		"dve_id":     c.dveID,
+		"server_url": c.serverURL,
+	})
+	return nil
+}
+
+func (c *DVEChannel) Stop(ctx context.Context) error {
+	c.setRunning(false)
+	return nil
+}
+
+func (c *DVEChannel) Send(ctx context.Context, msg bus.OutboundMessage) error {
+	url := fmt.Sprintf("%s/api/v1/dve/%s/agent/response", c.serverURL, c.dveID)
+	
+	payload := map[string]string{
+		"message": msg.Content,
+	}
+	body, err := json.Marshal(payload)
+	if err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+
+	req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, "POST", url, bytes.NewReader(body))
+	if err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
+
+	resp, err := c.client.Do(req)
+	if err != nil {
+		return fmt.Errorf("failed to send response to KNIRV-SERVER: %w", err)
+	}
+	defer resp.Body.Close()
+
+	if resp.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
+		return fmt.Errorf("KNIRV-SERVER returned status %d", resp.StatusCode)
+	}
+
+	return nil
+}

+package channels
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"fmt"
+	"os"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"strings"
+
+	"github.com/knirvcorp/knirvagent/pkg/bus"
+	"github.com/knirvcorp/knirvagent/pkg/logger"
+)
+
+type TerminalChannel struct {
+	*BaseChannel
+}
+
+func NewTerminalChannel(bus *bus.MessageBus) *TerminalChannel {
+	return &TerminalChannel{
+		BaseChannel: NewBaseChannel("terminal", nil, bus, nil),
+	}
+}
+
+func (c *TerminalChannel) Start(ctx context.Context) error {
+	c.setRunning(true)
+	logger.InfoC("channels", "Terminal channel started")
+	return nil
+}
+
+func (c *TerminalChannel) Stop(ctx context.Context) error {
+	c.setRunning(false)
+	return nil
+}
+
+func (c *TerminalChannel) Send(ctx context.Context, msg bus.OutboundMessage) error {
+	// Find all PTYs
+	entries, err := os.ReadDir("/dev/pts")
+	if err != nil {
+		return fmt.Errorf("failed to read /dev/pts: %w", err)
+	}
+
+	formattedMsg := fmt.Sprintf("\r\n\x1b[32m[KNIRVAGENT] %s\x1b[0m\r\n", msg.Content)
+
+	for _, entry := range entries {
+		// Only write to numbered PTYs (e.g., /dev/pts/0)
+		name := entry.Name()
+		if name == "ptmx" || name == "terminal" {
+			continue
+		}
+
+		path := filepath.Join("/dev/pts", name)
+		f, err := os.OpenFile(path, os.O_WRONLY|os.O_APPEND, 0)
+		if err != nil {
+			// Skip PTYs we can't open
+			continue
+		}
+		
+		_, _ = f.WriteString(formattedMsg)
+		_ = f.Close()
+	}
+
+	return nil
+}

49: 	logger     *FileLogger
50: 	loggerOnce sync.Once
51: )
52: 
53: // GetLogger returns the singleton file logger
54: func GetLogger() *FileLogger {
55: 	loggerOnce.Do(func() {
56: 		logger = &FileLogger{}
57: 		logger.init()
58: 	})
59: 	return logger
60: }
61: 
62: // init initializes the file logger
63: func (l *FileLogger) init() {
64: 	appDir, err := embedded.GetAppDataDir()
65: 	if err != nil {
66: 		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: Could not get app data dir: %v\n", err)
67: 		return
68: 	}
69: 
70: 	logDir := filepath.Join(appDir, "logs")
71: 	if err := os.MkdirAll(logDir, 0755); err != nil {
72: 		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: Could not create log directory: %v\n", err)
73: 		return
74: 	}
75: 
76: 	timestamp := time.Now().Format("20060102_150405")
77: 	logPath := filepath.Join(logDir, fmt.Sprintf("hasher-cli_%s.log", timestamp))
78: 
79: 	file, err := os.OpenFile(logPath, os.O_CREATE|os.O_WRONLY|os.O_APPEND, 0644)
80: 	if err != nil {
81: 		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: Could not open log file: %v\n", err)
82: 		return
83: 	}
84: 
85: 	l.file = file
86: 	l.writer = bufio.NewWriter(file)
87: 	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "CLI logs: %s\n", logPath)
88: }
89: 
90: // Write writes a log message to the file
91: func (l *FileLogger) Write(msg string) {
92: 	if l == nil || l.writer == nil {
93: 		return
94: 	}
95: 	l.mu.Lock()
96: 	defer l.mu.Unlock()
97: 	timestamp := time.Now().Format("2006/01/02 15:04:05")
98: 	l.writer.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("[%s] %s", timestamp, msg))
99: 	l.writer.Flush()
100: }
101: 
102: // Close closes the log file
103: func (l *FileLogger) Close() {
104: 	if l == nil || l.file == nil {
105: 		return
106: 	}
107: 	l.mu.Lock()
108: 	defer l.mu.Unlock()
109: 	l.writer.Flush()
110: 	l.file.Close()
111: }

581: // Update handles UI updates
582: func (m Model) Update(msg tea.Msg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
583: 	var cmd tea.Cmd
584: 	var cmds []tea.Cmd
585: 
586: 	switch msg := msg.(type) {
587: 	case tea.KeyMsg:
588: 		switch msg.Type {
589: 		case tea.KeyCtrlC:
590: 			return m, tea.Quit
591: 		}
592: 
593: 	case tea.MouseMsg:
594: 		cmds = append(cmds, m.handleMouse(msg))
595: 
596: 	case tea.WindowSizeMsg:
597: 		m, cmd = m.handleResize(msg)
598: 		cmds = append(cmds, cmd)
599: 
600: 	case updateResourceDataMsg:
601: 		m.ResourceData = msg.data
602: 		cmds = append(cmds, m.updateResourceData())
603: 
604: 	case AppendLogMsg:
605: 		m.ServerLogs = append(m.ServerLogs, msg.Log)
606: 		GetLogger().Write(msg.Log + "\n")
607: 		if len(m.ServerLogs) > 50 {
608: 			m.ServerLogs = m.ServerLogs[len(m.ServerLogs)-50:]
609: 		}
610: 		m.updateLogView()
611: 		// Continue polling for more logs if server is starting
612: 		if m.ServerStarting && !m.ServerReady {
613: 			cmds = append(cmds, tea.Tick(50*time.Millisecond, func(t time.Time) tea.Msg {
614: 				return pollServerLogsMsg{}
615: 			}))
616: 		}
617: 
618: 	case pollServerLogsMsg:
619: 		// Poll for more logs from the channel
620: 		if m.ServerStarting && !m.ServerReady {
621: 			select {
622: 			case log := <-m.LogChan:
623: 				m.ServerLogs = append(m.ServerLogs, log)
624: 				GetLogger().Write(log + "\n")
625: 				if len(m.ServerLogs) > 50 {
626: 					m.ServerLogs = m.ServerLogs[len(m.ServerLogs)-50:]
627: 				}
628: 				m.updateLogView()
629: 
630: 				// Check if server is now ready (message contains "is ready")
631: 				if strings.Contains(log, "is ready") {
632: 					// Trigger health check to update ServerReady state
633: 					cmds = append(cmds, m.checkServerHealth())
634: 				}
635: 			default:
636: 				// No log available, just continue
637: 			}
638: 			// Continue polling
639: 			cmds = append(cmds, tea.Tick(50*time.Millisecond, func(t time.Time) tea.Msg {
640: 				return pollServerLogsMsg{}
641: 			}))
642: 		}
643: 
644: 	case pollPipelineLogsMsg:
645: 		if m.PipelineRunning {
646: 			// Drain as many logs as possible in one tick to keep up with fast output
647: 			drained := 0
648: 			maxDrain := 20 // Process up to 20 logs per tick to avoid blocking the UI
649: 			for drained < maxDrain {
650: 				select {
651: 				case logMsg := <-m.PipelineLogChan:
652: 					m.PipelineLogs = append(m.PipelineLogs, logMsg.Log)
653: 					if len(m.PipelineLogs) > 100 {

1304: // renderInitScrollbar renders a vertical scrollbar for the initialization view
1305: func (m Model) renderInitScrollbar() string {
1306: 	// Viewport height
1307: 	viewportHeight := m.InitView.Height
1308: 	if viewportHeight <= 0 {
1309: 		viewportHeight = 10
1310: 	}
1311: 
1312: 	// Get total content lines
1313: 	totalLines := len(m.ServerLogs)
1314: 	if totalLines == 0 {
1315: 		// Empty scrollbar track
1316: 		return strings.Repeat("│\n", viewportHeight-1) + "│"
1317: 	}
1318: 
1319: 	// If content fits, show empty scrollbar track
1320: 	if totalLines <= viewportHeight {
1321: 		return strings.Repeat("│\n", viewportHeight-1) + "│"
1322: 	}
1323: 
1324: 	// Calculate scrollbar thumb size
1325: 	thumbHeight := viewportHeight * viewportHeight / totalLines
1326: 	if thumbHeight < 1 {
1327: 		thumbHeight = 1
1328: 	}
1329: 	if thumbHeight > viewportHeight {
1330: 		thumbHeight = viewportHeight
1331: 	}
1332: 
1333: 	// Calculate thumb position based on scroll offset
1334: 	maxScroll := totalLines - viewportHeight
1335: 	thumbPosition := 0
1336: 	if maxScroll > 0 && totalLines > 0 {
1337: 		thumbPosition = m.InitView.YOffset * (viewportHeight - thumbHeight) / maxScroll
1338: 		if thumbPosition < 0 {
1339: 			thumbPosition = 0
1340: 		}
1341: 		if thumbPosition > viewportHeight-thumbHeight {
1342: 			thumbPosition = viewportHeight - thumbHeight
1343: 		}
1344: 	}
1345: 
1346: 	// Build scrollbar
1347: 	var scrollbar strings.Builder
1348: 	for i := 0; i < viewportHeight; i++ {
1349: 		if i >= thumbPosition && i < thumbPosition+thumbHeight {
1350: 			scrollbar.WriteString("█")
1351: 		} else {
1352: 			scrollbar.WriteString("│")
1353: 		}
1354: 		if i < viewportHeight-1 {
1355: 			scrollbar.WriteString("\n")
1356: 		}
1357: 	}
1358: 
1359: 	return scrollbar.String()
1360: }

2702: func (m Model) runPipelineStage(binDir string, stageIndex int) tea.Cmd {
2703: 	return func() tea.Msg {
2704: 		if stageIndex >= len(m.PipelineStages) {
2705: 			return PipelineCompleteMsg{
2706: 				Success: true,
2707: 				Message: "Data pipeline completed successfully!",
2708: 			}
2709: 		}
2710: 
2711: 		stage := m.PipelineStages[stageIndex]
2712: 		binaryPath := filepath.Join(binDir, stage.BinName)
2713: 
2714: 		// Ensure binary exists and is executable
2715: 		if _, err := os.Stat(binaryPath); err != nil {
2716: 			// Try to find it in embedded if not in binDir
2717: 			var extractErr error
2718: 			binaryPath, extractErr = embedded.GetBinaryPath(stage.BinName)
2719: 			if extractErr != nil {
2720: 				return PipelineLogMsg{
2721: 					Log:        fmt.Sprintf("[%s] ❌ Binary not found: %s (%v)", time.Now().Format("15:04:05"), stage.BinName, extractErr),
2722: 					StageIndex: stageIndex,
2723: 					Error:      true,
2724: 				}
2725: 			}
2726: 		}
2727: 
2728: 		// For data-miner, ensure spacy library is available
2729: 		if stage.BinName == "data-miner" {
2730: 			m.ensureSpacyLib(binDir)
2731: 		}
2732: 
2733: 		// For data-trainer, ensure cuda library is available
2734: 		if stage.BinName == "data-trainer" {
2735: 			m.ensureCudaLib(binDir)
2736: 		}
2737: 
2738: 		// Create command
2739: 		var cmd *exec.Cmd
2740: 		if len(stage.Args) > 0 {
2741: 			cmd = exec.Command(binaryPath, stage.Args...)
2742: 		} else {
2743: 			cmd = exec.Command(binaryPath)
2744: 		}
2745: 		cmd.Dir = binDir
2746: 
2747: 		// Set LD_LIBRARY_PATH for required libraries
2748: 		if stage.BinName == "data-miner" || stage.BinName == "data-trainer" {
2749: 			cmd.Env = append(os.Environ(), "LD_LIBRARY_PATH="+binDir+":"+os.Getenv("LD_LIBRARY_PATH"))
2750: 		}
2751: 
2752: 		// Capture output for streaming
2753: 		stdout, err := cmd.StdoutPipe()
2754: 		if err != nil {
2755: 			return PipelineLogMsg{
2756: 				Log:        fmt.Sprintf("[%s] ❌ Failed to create stdout pipe: %v", time.Now().Format("15:04:05"), err),
2757: 				StageIndex: stageIndex,
2758: 				Error:      true,
2759: 			}
2760: 		}
2761: 		stderr, err := cmd.StderrPipe()
2762: 		if err != nil {
2763: 			return PipelineLogMsg{
2764: 				Log:        fmt.Sprintf("[%s] ❌ Failed to create stderr pipe: %v", time.Now().Format("15:04:05"), err),
2765: 				StageIndex: stageIndex,
2766: 				Error:      true,
2767: 			}
2768: 		}
2769: 
2770: 		logMsg := fmt.Sprintf("[%s] 🚀 Running %s (%s)...", time.Now().Format("15:04:05"), stage.Name, stage.Desc)
2771: 
2772: 		if err := cmd.Start(); err != nil {
2773: 			return PipelineLogMsg{
2774: 				Log:        fmt.Sprintf("[%s] ❌ Failed to start %s: %v", time.Now().Format("15:04:05"), stage.Name, err),
2775: 				StageIndex: stageIndex,
2776: 				Error:      true,
2777: 			}
2778: 		}
2779: 
2780: 		// Update global pipeline state
2781: 		pipelineState.Mu.Lock()
2782: 		pipelineState.Cmd = cmd
2783: 		pipelineState.Running = true
2784: 		pipelineState.Mu.Unlock()
2785: 
2786: 		// Stream output in a separate goroutine
2787: 		go m.streamPipelineOutput(cmd, stdout, stderr, stageIndex, stage)
2788: 
2789: 		return PipelineLogMsg{
2790: 			Log:        logMsg,
2791: 			StageIndex: stageIndex,
2792: 			Stage:      stage.Name,
2793: 		}
2794: 	}
2795: }

2798: func (m Model) ensureSpacyLib(binDir string) {
2799: 	// Check if library already exists in bin directory
2800: 	libPath := filepath.Join(binDir, "libspacy_wrapper.so")
2801: 	if _, err := os.Stat(libPath); err == nil {
2802: 		return // Library already exists
2803: 	}
2804: 
2805: 	// Try to find the library in common locations
2806: 	searchPaths := []string{
2807: 		filepath.Join(os.Getenv("HOME"), "Documents", "GitHub", "LAB", "HASHER", "pipeline", "1_DATA_MINER", "spacy", "lib", "libspacy_wrapper.so"),
2808: 		filepath.Join(os.Getenv("HOME"), "hasher", "pipeline", "1_DATA_MINER", "spacy", "lib", "libspacy_wrapper.so"),
2809: 		"/usr/local/lib/libspacy_wrapper.so",
2810: 	}
2811: 
2812: 	for _, srcPath := range searchPaths {
2813: 		if _, err := os.Stat(srcPath); err == nil {
2814: 			// Copy the library to bin directory
2815: 			data, err := os.ReadFile(srcPath)
2816: 			if err == nil {
2817: 				err = os.WriteFile(libPath, data, 0755)
2818: 				if err == nil {
2819: 					return // Successfully copied

2821: 			}
2822: 		}

2875: 		case "xterm", "xterm-color":
2876: 			terminalCmd = "xterm"

2878: 			terminalArgs = []string{"-title", "Hasher Pipeline: " + filepath.Base(binaryPath), "-e", "/bin/bash", "-c", shellCmd}
2879: 		default:
2880: 			terminalCmd = termEmulator
2881: 			shellCmd := fmt.Sprintf("cd '%s' && '%s' %s", workDir, binaryPath, argStr)
2882: 			terminalArgs = []string{"-e", "/bin/bash", "-c", shellCmd}
2883: 		}
2884: 	default:

2887: 		} else {

2889: 		}
2890: 		cmd.Dir = workDir

2892: 	}

2900: func (m Model) streamPipelineOutput(cmd *exec.Cmd, stdout io.ReadCloser, stderr io.ReadCloser, stageIndex int, stage PipelineStage) {
2901: 	defer stdout.Close()
2902: 	defer stderr.Close()
2903: 
2904: 	logger := GetLogger()
2905: 
2906: 	stdoutScanner := bufio.NewScanner(stdout)
2907: 	go func() {
2908: 		for stdoutScanner.Scan() {
2909: 			line := strings.TrimSpace(stdoutScanner.Text())
2910: 			if line != "" {
2911: 				// Truncate long lines for UI
2912: 				if len(line) > 150 {
2913: 					line = line[:147] + "..."
2914: 				}
2915: 				logMsg := fmt.Sprintf("[%s] %s", time.Now().Format("15:04:05"), line)
2916: 				m.PipelineLogChan <- PipelineLogMsg{Log: logMsg, StageIndex: stageIndex}
2917: 				logger.Write(logMsg + "\n")
2918: 			}
2919: 		}
2920: 	}()
2921: 
2922: 	stderrScanner := bufio.NewScanner(stderr)
2923: 	go func() {
2924: 		for stderrScanner.Scan() {
2925: 			line := strings.TrimSpace(stderrScanner.Text())
2926: 			if line != "" {
2927: 				// Truncate long lines for UI
2928: 				if len(line) > 150 {
2929: 					line = line[:147] + "..."
2930: 				}
2931: 				logMsg := fmt.Sprintf("[%s] [stderr] %s", time.Now().Format("15:04:05"), line)
2932: 				m.PipelineLogChan <- PipelineLogMsg{Log: logMsg, StageIndex: stageIndex}
2933: 				logger.Write(logMsg + "\n")
2934: 			}
2935: 		}
2936: 	}()
2937: 
2938: 	err := cmd.Wait()
2939: 	pipelineState.Mu.Lock()
2940: 	pipelineState.Running = false
2941: 	pipelineState.Mu.Unlock()
2942: 
2943: 	if err != nil {
2944: 		m.PipelineLogChan <- PipelineLogMsg{
2945: 			Log:        fmt.Sprintf("[%s] ❌ %s failed: %v", time.Now().Format("15:04:05"), stage.Name, err),
2946: 			StageIndex: stageIndex,
2947: 			Error:      true,
2948: 		}
2949: 	} else {
2950: 		m.PipelineLogChan <- PipelineLogMsg{

114: // StartDriver starts the hasher-host subprocess
115: func (c *Controller) StartDriver(ctx context.Context) error {
116: 	// Check if hasher-host is already running
117: 	if port := findRunningHasherHost(); port > 0 {
118: 		c.model.ServerReady = true
119: 		c.model.ServerStarting = false
120: 		c.apiClient = client.NewAPIClient(port)
121: 		return nil
122: 	}
123: 
124: 	// Force extract a fresh hasher-host binary
125: 	hostPath, err := embedded.GetHasherHostPathForce()
126: 	if err != nil {
127: 		return fmt.Errorf("failed to extract hasher-host: %w", err)
128: 	}
129: 
130: 	// Get the binary directory for working directory
131: 	binDir, err := embedded.GetBinDir()
132: 	if err != nil {
133: 		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get binary directory: %w", err)
134: 	}
135: 
136: 	// Build hasher-host arguments
137: 	var args []string
138: 
139: 	// Check if device configuration is available
140: 	deviceConfig, _ := config.LoadDeviceConfig()
141: 	if deviceConfig != nil && deviceConfig.IP != "" {
142: 		args = append(args, "--device="+deviceConfig.IP)
143: 		args = append(args, "--discover=false")
144: 		args = append(args, "--force-redeploy=true")
145: 		if deviceConfig.Password != "" {
146: 			args = append(args, "--server-ssh-password="+deviceConfig.Password)
147: 		}
148: 	} else {
149: 		args = append(args, "--discover=true")
150: 		args = append(args, "--auto-deploy=true")
151: 	}
152: 
153: 	if deviceConfig != nil && deviceConfig.FramesDir != "" {
154: 		args = append(args, "--frames-dir="+deviceConfig.FramesDir)
155: 	}
156: 
157: 	if deviceConfig != nil && deviceConfig.CGMinerHost != "" {
158: 		args = append(args, "--cgminer-host="+deviceConfig.CGMinerHost)
159: 	}
160: 
161: 	// Start hasher-host with configured arguments
162: 	cmd := exec.Command(hostPath, args...)
163: 	cmd.Dir = binDir
164: 
165: 	// Pass device credentials via environment variables
166: 	cmd.Env = os.Environ()
167: 	if deviceConfig != nil {
168: 		if deviceConfig.IP != "" {
169: 			cmd.Env = append(cmd.Env, "DEVICE_IP="+deviceConfig.IP)
170: 		}
171: 		if deviceConfig.Password != "" {
172: 			cmd.Env = append(cmd.Env, "DEVICE_PASSWORD="+deviceConfig.Password)
173: 		}
174: 		if deviceConfig.Username != "" {
175: 			cmd.Env = append(cmd.Env, "DEVICE_USERNAME="+deviceConfig.Username)
176: 		}
177: 	}
178: 
179: 	// Create pipes to capture output
180: 	stdoutPipe, err := cmd.StdoutPipe()
181: 	if err != nil {
182: 		return fmt.Errorf("failed to create stdout pipe: %w", err)
183: 	}
184: 	stderrPipe, err := cmd.StderrPipe()
185: 	if err != nil {
186: 		return fmt.Errorf("failed to create stderr pipe: %w", err)
187: 	}
188: 
189: 	if err := cmd.Start(); err != nil {
190: 		return fmt.Errorf("failed to start hasher-host: %w", err)
191: 	}
192: 
193: 	c.serverCmd = cmd
194: 	c.model.ServerCmd = cmd
195: 	c.model.ServerStarting = true
196: 
197: 	// Stream output
198: 	go c.streamOutput(stdoutPipe, stderrPipe)
199: 
200: 	// Wait for server to be ready
201: 	go c.waitForServerReady()
202: 
203: 	return nil
204: }

206: // streamOutput streams stdout/stderr to the log channel
207: func (c *Controller) streamOutput(stdout, stderr io.ReadCloser) {
208: 	go func() {
209: 		defer stdout.Close()
210: 		buf := make([]byte, 1024)
211: 		for {
212: 			n, err := stdout.Read(buf)
213: 			if err != nil {
214: 				return
215: 			}
216: 			if n > 0 {
217: 				select {
218: 				case c.logChan <- string(buf[:n]):
219: 				default:
220: 				}
221: 			}
222: 		}
223: 	}()
224: 
225: 	go func() {
226: 		defer stderr.Close()
227: 		buf := make([]byte, 1024)
228: 		for {
229: 			n, err := stderr.Read(buf)
230: 			if err != nil {
231: 				return
232: 			}
233: 			if n > 0 {
234: 				select {
235: 				case c.logChan <- string(buf[:n]):
236: 				default:
237: 				}
238: 			}
239: 		}
240: 	}()
241: }

243: // waitForServerReady waits for the hasher-host to be ready
244: func (c *Controller) waitForServerReady() {
245: 	startTime := time.Now()
246: 	timeout := 5 * time.Minute
247: 	portFile := "/tmp/hasher-host.port"
248: 
249: 	for time.Since(startTime) < timeout {
250: 		portBytes, err := os.ReadFile(portFile)
251: 		if err == nil {
252: 			port, err := strconv.Atoi(strings.TrimSpace(string(portBytes)))
253: 			if err == nil && isHasherHostRunning(port) {
254: 				c.model.ServerReady = true
255: 				c.model.ServerStarting = false
256: 				c.apiClient = client.NewAPIClient(port)
257: 				return
258: 			}
259: 		}
260: 		time.Sleep(500 * time.Millisecond)
261: 	}
262: }

267: 		return nil
268: 	}

270: 	fmt.Println("Shutting down hasher-host...")
271: 
272: 	// Try graceful shutdown via API
273: 	if c.apiClient != nil {
274: 		shutdownURL := fmt.Sprintf("http://localhost:%d/api/v1/shutdown", 8080)
275: 		http.Post(shutdownURL, "application/json", nil)
276: 	}
277: 
278: 	// Wait for process to terminate with timeout
279: 	done := make(chan error, 1)
280: 	go func() {
281: 		done <- c.serverCmd.Wait()
282: 	}()
283: 
284: 	select {
285: 	case <-done:
286: 		fmt.Println("hasher-host shut down successfully.")
287: 	case <-time.After(15 * time.Second):
288: 		fmt.Println("hasher-host shutdown timeout, force killing...")
289: 		c.serverCmd.Process.Kill()
290: 	}
291: 
292: 	c.serverCmd = nil
293: 	c.model.ServerCmd = nil
294: 	c.model.ServerReady = false
295: 	c.model.ServerStarting = false
296: 	c.apiClient = nil
297: 
298: 	return nil

447: // ManageRules manages logical rules
448: func (c *Controller) ManageRules(ctx context.Context, action string, args ...string) (string, error) {
449: 	validator, err := validation.NewLogicalValidator()
450: 	if err != nil {
451: 		return "", fmt.Errorf("error creating validator: %w", err)
452: 	}
453: 
454: 	switch action {
455: 	case "list":
456: 		var output strings.Builder
457: 		output.WriteString("Logical Validation Rules\n")
458: 		output.WriteString("==========================\n\n")
459: 
460: 		if len(args) > 0 {
461: 			domain := args[0]
462: 			rules, err := validator.KnowledgeBase.GetRules(domain)
463: 			if err != nil {
464: 				return "", err
465: 			}
466: 			output.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("Domain: %s (%d rules)\n\n", domain, len(rules)))
467: 			for i, rule := range rules {
468: 				output.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("[%d] %s\n", i, rule.String()))
469: 			}
470: 		} else {
471: 			for domain, rules := range validator.KnowledgeBase.Domains {
472: 				output.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("Domain: %s (%d rules)\n", domain, len(rules)))
473: 				for i, rule := range rules {
474: 					output.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("  [%d] %s\n", i, rule.String()))
475: 				}
476: 			}
477: 		}
478: 		return output.String(), nil
479: 
480: 	case "add":
481: 		if len(args) < 3 {
482: 			return "", fmt.Errorf("usage: add <domain> <type> <conclusion>")
483: 		}
484: 		domain := args[0]
485: 		ruleType := args[1]
486: 		conclusion := strings.Join(args[2:], " ")
487: 
488: 		rule, err := validation.NewLogicalRule(ruleType, []string{}, conclusion, "Added via API")
489: 		if err != nil {
490: 			return "", err
491: 		}
492: 
493: 		if err := validator.KnowledgeBase.AddRule(domain, rule); err != nil {
494: 			return "", err
495: 		}
496: 
497: 		return fmt.Sprintf("Rule added to domain '%s'", domain), nil
498: 
499: 	case "delete":
500: 		if len(args) < 2 {
501: 			return "", fmt.Errorf("usage: delete <domain> <index>")
502: 		}
503: 		domain := args[0]
504: 		var index int
505: 		fmt.Sscanf(args[1], "%d", &index)
506: 
507: 		if err := validator.KnowledgeBase.RemoveRule(domain, index); err != nil {
508: 			return "", err
509: 		}
510: 
511: 		return fmt.Sprintf("Rule %d deleted from domain '%s'", index, domain), nil
512: 
513: 	default:
514: 		return "", fmt.Errorf("unknown action: %s", action)
515: 	}
516: }

533: // RunPipeline runs the data pipeline
534: func (c *Controller) RunPipeline(ctx context.Context, pipelineType string) error {
535: 	binDir, err := embedded.GetBinDir()
536: 	if err != nil {
537: 		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get binary directory: %w", err)
538: 	}
539: 
540: 	// Build pipeline stages based on type
541: 	stages := buildPipelineStages(pipelineType)
542: 
543: 	c.model.PipelineRunning = true
544: 	c.model.PipelineStage = "initializing"
545: 	c.model.PipelineStages = stages
546: 	c.model.PipelineType = pipelineType
547: 
548: 	// Run stages sequentially
549: 	for i, stage := range stages {
550: 		c.model.PipelineStage = stage.Name
551: 
552: 		binaryPath := filepath.Join(binDir, stage.BinName)
553: 
554: 		// Ensure binary exists
555: 		if _, err := os.Stat(binaryPath); err != nil {
556: 			// Try to find it in embedded
557: 			var extractErr error
558: 			binaryPath, extractErr = embedded.GetBinaryPath(stage.BinName)
559: 			if extractErr != nil {
560: 				c.model.PipelineRunning = false
561: 				return fmt.Errorf("binary not found: %s (%w)", stage.BinName, extractErr)
562: 			}
563: 		}
564: 
565: 		// Create command
566: 		var cmd *exec.Cmd
567: 		if len(stage.Args) > 0 {
568: 			cmd = exec.Command(binaryPath, stage.Args...)
569: 		} else {
570: 			cmd = exec.Command(binaryPath)
571: 		}
572: 		cmd.Dir = binDir
573: 
574: 		// Set up environment
575: 		if stage.BinName == "data-miner" || stage.BinName == "data-trainer" {
576: 			cmd.Env = append(os.Environ(), "LD_LIBRARY_PATH="+binDir+":"+os.Getenv("LD_LIBRARY_PATH"))
577: 		}
578: 
579: 		// Capture output
580: 		stdout, err := cmd.StdoutPipe()
581: 		if err != nil {
582: 			return fmt.Errorf("failed to create stdout pipe: %w", err)
583: 		}
584: 		stderr, err := cmd.StderrPipe()
585: 		if err != nil {
586: 			return fmt.Errorf("failed to create stderr pipe: %w", err)
587: 		}
588: 
589: 		if err := cmd.Start(); err != nil {
590: 			c.model.PipelineRunning = false
591: 			return fmt.Errorf("failed to start %s: %w", stage.Name, err)
592: 		}
593: 
594: 		// Update pipeline state
595: 		c.pipelineState.Mu.Lock()
596: 		c.pipelineState.Cmd = cmd
597: 		c.pipelineState.Running = true
598: 		c.pipelineState.Mu.Unlock()
599: 
600: 		// Stream output
601: 		go c.streamPipelineOutput(cmd, stdout, stderr, i, stage)
602: 
603: 		// Wait for command to complete
604: 		err = cmd.Wait()
605: 		c.pipelineState.Mu.Lock()
606: 		c.pipelineState.Running = false
607: 		c.pipelineState.Mu.Unlock()
608: 
609: 		if err != nil {
610: 			c.model.PipelineRunning = false
611: 			return fmt.Errorf("%s failed: %w", stage.Name, err)
612: 		}
613: 	}
614: 
615: 	c.model.PipelineRunning = false
616: 	c.model.PipelineStage = "complete"
617: 	return nil
618: }

630: 				if len(line) > 150 {
631: 					line = line[:147] + "..."
632: 				}
633: 				logMsg := fmt.Sprintf("[%s] %s", time.Now().Format("15:04:05"), line)
634: 				c.pipelineLogChan <- PipelineLogMsg{
635: 					Log:        logMsg,
636: 					StageIndex: stageIndex,
637: 					Stage:      stage.Name,
638: 				}
639: 			}
640: 		}
641: 	}()
642: 
643: 	go func() {
644: 		scanner := bufio.NewScanner(stderr)
645: 		for scanner.Scan() {
646: 			line := strings.TrimSpace(scanner.Text())
647: 			if line != "" {
648: 				if len(line) > 150 {
649: 					line = line[:147] + "..."
650: 				}
651: 				logMsg := fmt.Sprintf("[%s] [stderr] %s", time.Now().Format("15:04:05"), line)
652: 				c.pipelineLogChan <- PipelineLogMsg{
653: 					Log:        logMsg,
654: 					StageIndex: stageIndex,
655: 					Stage:      stage.Name,
656: 				}
657: 			}
658: 		}
659: 	}()
660: }
